title: Chanute Air Force Base, Water Tower, Extender Street, Rantoul, Champaign County, IL
notes: Significance: In response to World War II massive mobilization, Structure 44 a 300,000 gallon water tower was constructed in 1939. It is a contributing element of the Chanute AFB Historic District.
